issues.title: 标准条款被修改: 1处偏离
issues.description: EU 2021/914 标准条款中发现 1 处修改，可能削弱对数据主体的保护。
issues.recommended_action: 逐项复核偏离条款。涉及不可冲突条款的修改应恢复为标准文本。

issues.title: [HIGH] Annex I.B: Transfer description contains health/medical data terms but special category data is NOT declared. U
issues.description: Transfer description contains health/medical data terms but special category data is NOT declared. Under GDPR Article 9, health data requires explicit consent or another exemption, and SCCs alone may not be sufficient.
issues.recommended_action: (1) Verify whether the data includes special categories; (2) If yes, declare them explicitly in Annex I.B; (3) Assess whether supplementary measures are needed for special category data transfers.

issues.title: [HIGH] Annex II: Annex II (Technical and Organisational Measures) appears empty or could not be parsed. Without speci
issues.description: Annex II (Technical and Organisational Measures) appears empty or could not be parsed. Without specified TOMs, the SCC does not demonstrate adequate data protection safeguards.
issues.recommended_action: Complete Annex II with specific technical and organisational measures, including encryption standards, access controls, incident response, and data minimization practices.

issues.title: [HIGH] Clause 14: Third country transfer identified to: India. No Transfer Impact Assessment (TIA) has been provided.
issues.description: Third country transfer identified to: India. No Transfer Impact Assessment (TIA) has been provided. Under GDPR and Schrems II (C-311/18), a documented TIA is required before transferring personal data to a third country without an adequacy decision.
issues.recommended_action: Complete a TIA for transfers to India. The TIA must: (1) assess the laws and practices of the destination country; (2) evaluate whether they impinge on the SCCs' effectiveness; (3) identify and implement supplementary measures as needed.

issues.title: [HIGH] Annex II: Third country transfer to non-adequate jurisdiction 'India' requires Schrems II supplementary measur
issues.description: Third country transfer to non-adequate jurisdiction 'India' requires Schrems II supplementary measures. Technical: NOT FOUND. Contractual: NOT FOUND. Organizational: NOT FOUND.
issues.recommended_action: Implement Schrems II supplementary measures: (1) Technical — end-to-end encryption with EU-held keys, zero-access architecture; (2) Contractual — government access notification obligation, commitment to challenge unlawful requests, transparency reporting; (3) Organizational — independent annual audit, data minimization.

issues.title: [HIGH] Clause 15: Semantic weakening (information_provision): Information provision made discretionary
issues.description: Semantic weakening (information_provision): Information provision made discretionary
issues.recommended_action: Restore the standard EU 2021/914 text for this provision.
